landing_demo_transcript_body: Discover suggested housing and search by area. Open a property to review its photos and price plus room count and rental details then save it to favorites. Choose a day and an available time to request a visit. The owner dashboard brings visit requests and property statistics together with access to contracts and rent management. Listings and requests in this demo are examples.

landing_faq_one_question: Is my phone number shown to owners or tenants?
landing_faq_one_answer: Use the app chat to discuss a property. Check the contact information shown in your visit details before sharing personal details.
landing_faq_two_question: How do I verify my account?
landing_faq_two_answer: Follow the identity verification steps in the app and submit the requested documents. You can follow your verification status in your account.
landing_faq_three_question: Can any user see my ID documents?
landing_faq_three_answer: No. Identity documents are only used for internal review and are never shared with another user.
landing_faq_four_question: How do I book a property visit?
landing_faq_four_answer: Open the property details then choose Book a visit and select a suitable day and time before waiting for owner confirmation.
landing_faq_five_question: How does an owner add a property?
landing_faq_five_answer: From the owner dashboard choose Add property and complete the details media pricing and ownership proof steps.
landing_faq_six_answer: A recent electricity or water bill ownership contract or lease contract. Documents are used for internal review only.
landing_faq_seven_question: Can I use the app as a guest?
landing_faq_seven_answer: Yes. You can browse without registering but you need a verified account to chat or book a visit.
landing_faq_eight_question: What happens if my property is rejected?
landing_faq_eight_answer: You will receive the rejection reason and required changes then you can upload the corrected information again.

rental_mode_change_help: The other mode will be kept in your local draft. Publishing this change needs server validation. it does not cancel requests or end leases.
rental_scope_change_help: Relevant terms are retained. Select accommodation again where needed. hidden fields are excluded from submission.
rental_inherited: Use shared defaults for these terms
rental_choose_offer: Choose the accommodation before requesting a viewing
rental_scope_filter_unavailable: Rental-scope filtering is not available on this server yet.
rental_select_for_price: Choose an offer to see its price and terms
rental_price_period_required: Prices are compared within the selected rent period.
rental_terms_changed: This offer changed. Review its current price and terms before requesting a viewing.
rental_not_available: The selected offer is no longer available. Your selection has not been changed.
rental_snapshot_missing: The original accommodation details were not supplied.
rental_historical_terms: Accommodation and terms at the time of the request
rental_viewing_only: A viewing is an appointment. Acceptance does not rent or reserve the accommodation.
rental_property_photos: Property photos. accommodation associations are not confirmed
rental_media_upload_first: Upload recovery preserves photo IDs. Photo associations are applied after the images are uploaded.
rental_chat_context_help: This is viewing context for the existing conversation.
rental_incompatible_response: The server did not confirm the rental inventory. Your draft is retained. publishing was not confirmed.
rental_archive_help: Archive only this offer. The server checks requests and leases. the property is retained.
rental_publication_review: Offer changes are submitted for property review. Review acceptance alone does not confirm public visibility.
rental_legacy_flow: Continue with the existing property listing
rental_gallery_accommodation: Photos of this accommodation and shared spaces
rental_property_video: This video covers the physical property. It may include other accommodation.
rental_persisted_scope_locked: Published accommodation selections are locked. Changing them requires a verified server transition that checks requests and leases.
rental_draft_saved: Draft saved on this device. It has not been published or saved to the server.
rental_parent_room_photos: Photos of the shared room containing this bed
rental_home_empty_help: Try another rent period or view all with more filters.
rental_duplicate_photos: Choose unique property photos. The same photo cannot be included twice.
rental_photos_check_failed: Some photos could not be read. Your draft is retained. Replace the affected files and try again.
rental_discovery_incompatible: The server did not confirm property results for these filters. Try again.
rental_supporting_property_help: These details describe the parent property. They do not describe the size or contents of the accommodation offered.
rental_shared_edit_help: These property details and media are shared by all offers in this property. Changes may affect the other offers.
rental_shared_facilities_input: Shared spaces and facilities one per line
rental_draft_details_help: Room area, furnishing, contents, bed provisions and shared-space details are saved on this device until the backend supports them.
rental_group_selection_help: Select at least two distinct rooms. The price covers all selected rooms together. Use a separate offer for rooms rented independently.
rental_independent_offer_help: An independent offer has its own accommodation, price and availability. Property information is collected only once.
rental_accommodation_required: Identify the selected rooms or bed, enter room capacity, and fix any overlapping allocations.
rental_room_area_invalid: Enter a positive room area or leave it blank if unknown.
rental_unit_photo_help: Associate relevant photos from the property media below. The property photo and video requirements apply once. New photo associations are saved locally until supported by the server.
rental_group_combined_area: Combined area of included rooms square metres
rental_group_area_unknown: Combined room area is unknown until every included room has a known area.
rental_physical_bed_count: Identified physical beds in this room
rental_room_identity_required: Enter a name or identifier for this room.
rental_shared_room_capacity_invalid: A shared room must accommodate at least two people.
rental_capacity_help: Capacity is the maximum number of people the room can accommodate. It does not indicate current occupancy or available beds.
rental_no_accommodation_details: Accommodation details were not supplied. Property specifications are shown separately.
rental_room_name_required: Enter a room name and positive capacity.
rental_bed_name_required: Enter a name for this bed and identify its shared room.
rental_form_details_progress: Accommodation and property context step 1 of 3
rental_choose_accommodation_to_edit: Choose the accommodation you want to edit.
rental_property_media_once: Property photos and video shared across these offers
rental_category_unspecified_hint: These listings have no confirmed accommodation type. Their property type does not identify what is rented.
rental_category_loaded_hint: Categories apply to loaded properties. Load more to check the remaining pages.
rental_category_empty_title: No matching accommodation in this category
rental_category_empty_hint: Choose another accommodation type or load more properties when more pages are available.
rental_category_search_unavailable: Discovery by accommodation type requires the rental-offer search service.
feature_stored_accounting_amount: This is the amount stored on this record. The saved offer terms are shown separately.
feature_signing_unavailable: Digital signing is not available yet. You can review your saved lease.
feature_checkout_unavailable: Online rent payment is not available yet. You can still review your invoice and payment status.
feature_alert_delivery_unavailable: Your search criteria are saved. Automatic alert delivery is not available yet.
feature_promotion_worker_unavailable: Your promotion request is recorded. Automatic visibility and impression tracking are not available yet.
